# C07 — Conditions of Worldhood

## #0

A world becomes inhabitable through the conditions that let something appear, matter and admit a response. Language, memory, bodily capacity, tools, rules and other participants do more than supply contents for a finished world-picture. They condition what can be distinguished and which actions are possible from here.

C07 names that constituting relation. [C37 — World-Picture / World-Atlas](C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **qualifies** its difference from representation: a picture selects relations within a world; an atlas coordinates pictures and their transformations. Worldhood includes the conditions under which either can be made, encountered and used.

## #1

The explanatory direction reverses. An agent models its world; the context-world also constitutes this agent's capacity to model anything. Change the memory available, the language in use, the permitted instruments or the interlocutor, and the question itself can acquire different terms. The world is active within the standpoint from which it is represented.

[A26 — Objective Internality](../A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **grounds** this reversal. Its historical developmental carrier makes three operations explicit: the field is **notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted**. Marks make relations articulable; rules constrain what can follow; exclusions make this actual determination emerge against alternatives. The three belong together. A visible output alone does not disclose the world from which it became possible.

## #2

The distinction between internal and external is relative to an operation. A permission imposed by another institution can nevertheless be constitutive of what an agent can do. A remembered encounter is internal to a later decision while carrying a history that the deciding agent did not author. The field's interior is not bounded by the skin of a device or the location of a memory store.

[C41 — Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** the inspectable organisation of this context-world. [C08 — Context Frame](C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) **defines** a bounded arrangement through which it can be investigated. Neither the frame nor its inventory exhausts the conditions of worldhood. What a frame leaves outside can remain materially consequential within it.

## #3

Worldhood has both a present configuration and a formed history. A map of currently possible transitions answers one question; the actual passage by which this configuration arose answers another. The sequence can change the field of possibilities, and that changed field conditions the next sequence.

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md|Taylor — Symbolon Dynamics]] **grounds** this relation in “Objective internality” and “Two temporalities, two logics.” Synchronic configuration and diachronic trajectory are distinct readings. A phase-space models configurations and trajectories; it does not replace the world whose activity it models. The authorial operation can be retained without treating psychic energy, mathematical dynamics and computational state as one evidence class.

## #4

Another locally grounded world can affect the conditions from which this one next acts. That is stronger than adding another opinion to a store. A contribution can alter what counts as evidence, which distinction is available, or whether a route of action remains legitimate. It must also remain answerable to the source-world from which it came.

[A30 — Objective Co-Internality](../A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** this plural relation. One participant does not become mere context for the other; shared conditions do not create a super-subject by aggregation. The ratified R16.7 correction preserves both local grounding and the capacity to meet.

[C09 — Diaphaneity](C09-Diaphaneity.md) **tests** whether the constituting relation can be read through the resulting account. Making an output observable and exposing the worldhood of its production are different achievements.

## #5→0

C07 **returns-to** [the Process dossier](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/process.md) when an account changes what can subsequently appear, matter or be acted upon. Bergson’s melody supplies a precise qualitative comparison: the arriving note reorganises the heard whole, so the return concerns changed significance as well as an added item. The concept also **returns-to** [the Process-science companion](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/DEVELOPMENT.md) with the difference between this conscious duration and Whitehead’s metaphysical account of achieved occasions contributing to later becoming. The native constituting relation preserves the operative reality of changed memory, reference and permission. Counting those changes gives an inspectable chronology; their existence neither establishes nor negates an artificial subject-pole.

Conditions of Worldhood **returns-to** [the developed Bohm dossier](../../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/bohm.md) through a form’s dependence on the field that makes it available. The Peat interview’s distributed dye and holographic information distinguish concealed organisation from absence; the postmodern-science essay gives enfolding and unfolding priority in Bohm’s proposed interpretation. The native constituting relation concerns what can appear, matter and be acted upon, beyond the resulting picture. The comparison keeps each source’s scope: a region is not an exhaustively readable copy of the universe, and a physical illustration does not establish the full ontological claim.

An achieved account can change attention, action or infrastructure and thereby enter the conditions of later accounts. Return is causal as well as interpretive: what was produced becomes part of what can next produce a difference. [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account]] **grounds** the Region relation at evidence register3. A region lets naming and counting occur; a mature account returns to encounter within that region.

C07 **returns-to** [A22 — World-Picture to World-Atlas](../A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md): coordinating views must retain the worldhood that makes their differences consequential. [A34 — Order of Dependence](../A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **extends** the ontological claim. The inspectability of an agent's context-world neither proves nor disproves a phenomenal subject-pole; the native Subject → objective internality → object argument retains its separate force.

**Depth Restoration:** reversal of explanatory direction, notational/nomological/exclusion triad, operational interiority, configuration/history and plural return are restored. C07 owns conditions of worldhood; C37 owns representational transformation; C41 owns the situated inspectable interior.

**Unresolved Delta:** the exact genealogies of worldhood, environment and lifeworld in their different traditions remain source-specific work. This page develops the authorial usage rather than attributing one definition to phenomenology, enactivism or Agentworld. No implementation or phenomenal finding is claimed.
